procedural_matters: EST 98 was represented by Elari Teras.
The Race committee was represented by Giancarlo Crevatin.
Fiorella Nicolari, Alberto Caporro and Marin Kustic, members of international jury, attended the hearing as observers.
facts: Race No. 7 for the blue fleet was started at 14:40.
The first boat of the blue fleet rounded mark 1 approximately at 14:50-14:52.
The protest time limit for Division A on 4th April was 17:06.
When EST 98 came ashore, the competitor discussed with his coach about approximately ten minutes, took afterwards care of his boat.
conclusions: EST 98 failed to deliver the request for redress within the protest time limit or within 2 hours after the incident (whichever is later), as required by RRS 61.2(b)(1). There was no good reason for the protest committee to extend the time. Therefore the request for redress is invalid under RRS 61.3.
decision: The request for redress is invalid, the hearing is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1).
